I've been looking into that week-long commitment for the kids in late May, and it seems like a great way for them to refine their physical {{1}} before the summer starts. If we decide on the full-day option, it actually works out to be a better value than just picking one half, especially since they'd get that extra time for social {{2}} during the break between sessions.

The first half of the day is really about the technical {{3}} of movement, while the later portion shifts toward the more competitive and {{4}} side of things. It's interesting that the organizers have set a price that essentially penalizes choosing the afternoon over the morning if you're only doing a half-day. Either way, it's a chance for them to {{5}} their abilities across multiple disciplines rather than just sticking to one sport.

Let me know what you think about the budget.

Best,
Marcus
